title: Jewel Toned Croatian Broccoli Gratin
description: A comforting Croatian dish featuring broccoli, nuka-pickle, and a garlicky glassy-jelly sauce, perfect for a cold evening. This ovo-vegetarian-friendly recipe is sure to become a favorite.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add the broccoli to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
In a separate saucepan, whisk together the flour and milk, and cook over medium heat until the mixture thickens.
Remove the sauce from the heat and stir in the vegetarian cheese until melted and smooth.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked broccoli, nuka-pickle, and garlicky sauce, and season with salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with additional shredded cheese.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the sauce is bubbly.
Remove the gratin from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
